assessment: In this manuscript, Meyer and co-workers further contribute to our understanding of how proteins are modified with carbohydrates on asparagine residues, N-glycosylation. They analyze this in the thermoacidophilic archaea Sulfolobus acidocaldarius and characterize Agl24 as a key player in the N-glycosylation pathway in this organism. These findings advance the glycobiology field and reveal how distinct mechanisms have arisen across evolution to post-translationally modify protein structures.
